text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: release r2.4.9 -> eu-west-1 (10% traffic). Commit: 6f4a2b3. CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345 :rocket:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: high 5xx rate (>18%) on service `inference-eu-canary`. Paging ben (on-call).
sam: on it, seeing error spike at 16:32 UTC. Logs show NPE in KVCache.
ben: got the page, pulling logs now. Sam can you paste sample stack?
sam: here: ```java.lang.NullPointerException at com.redwood.kv.KVCache.get(KVCache.java:132) at com.redwood.infer.Prefetcher.fetch(Prefetcher.java:58)```
carla: I pushed a canary config earlier enabling aggressive prefetch windows. That lines up.
priya: suggestion: flip feature flag `enable_prefetch_v2` off on canary immediately. Command: `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/v1/enable_prefetch_v2 -d '{"env":"eu-west-1","value":false}'`
ben: doing flag kill on canary now. @deploy-bot can you confirm flag propagation?
deploy-bot: Flag change accepted. `enable_prefetch_v2=false` applied to eu-west-1 canary (propagation ~15s).
sam: errors dropping from 18% -> ~4% after flag flip, but there are residual tail 5xx. I think reverting the single commit 6f4a2b3 (prefetch tweak) is safer than full rollback.
carla: ack. I'll open a revert PR (hotpatch) for commit 6f4a2b3 and push to hotpatch branch.
carla: PR created: https://git.redwood/internal/r2.4.9/revert-6f4a2b3 (title: revert: prefetch aggressive window)
deploy-bot: Hotpatch build triggered for branch `hotpatch/revert-6f4a2b3`. CI tests running.
incident-bot: Customer impact note: partial degradation for EU canary tenants between 16:32-16:45 UTC. Estimated ~3k failed requests, <1% of global traffic. Ops outreach initiated to impacted accounts.
ben: hotpatch PR looks good, merging and deploying to canary now.
deploy-bot: Hotpatch deployed to canary (hotpatch/revert-6f4a2b3). Monitoring for 10m.
sam: 5xx back to baseline (~0.5%), latency normal. Marking rollback successful. :white_check_mark:
alice: I'll take handoff at 17:00 UTC. Ben please prepare a short handoff note and next steps.
ben: writing handoff: root cause likely NPE when prefetch buffer empty + aggressive prefetch path not null-safe. Mitigations performed: feature flag kill, revert single commit, hotpatch deploy. Customer impact: ~3k failed requests, no SLA breach currently. Follow-ups: INF-1743 to add null-safety guard + canary smoke for prefetch.
priya: opening ticket INF-1743 now and assigning to carla for the fix and to sam for monitoring/alerts.
carla: will add defensive checks and a unit test to reproduce empty prefetch case.
incident-bot: Incident status: RESOLVED -> MONITORING. Handoff scheduled: ben -> alice at 17:00 UTC.
ben: handing off to alice, all dashboards stable, no ongoing errors.
alice: ack, taking over. I'll coordinate customer follow-up and draft the postmortem.
sam: quick follow-up action: add CI smoke that toggles prefetch flag on/off in staging to catch flag-config regressions.
incident-bot: Incident closed for active remediation. Postmortem task created and linked to INF-1743. Thanks team :pray:
